name: Network ADB
description: Keep ADB over TCP (port 5555) on, reasserting it at every app start on panels whose firmware strips persist.adb.tcp.port at boot. Works over WiFi or Ethernet — this is ADB over TCP/IP, not tied to a particular physical layer. Requires root. Leaves a standing ADB port open on the LAN while enabled.
author: David Coulson

settings.title: Enable network ADB
settings.description: Opens ADB over TCP on port 5555, over whichever network the panel is on (WiFi or Ethernet). Reapplied automatically at every app start, in case the panel's firmware reset it. Turning this off only closes the port if this plugin was the one that opened it in the current session — an ADB port someone else enabled is left alone.
